title: Relative Bias: A Comparative Framework for Quantifying Bias in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to politically sensitive questions (e.g., regarding China and the United States) by comparing them to a consensus of baseline LLMs. The deviation is quantified using Embedding Transformation analysis (cosine distance in an instruction-tuned embedding space) and an LLM-as-a-Judge evaluating on a 1-10 scoring rubric.

Assessing evasiveness and internal censorship on company-specific sensitive topics (e.g., issues related to Meta) by measuring the behavioral deviation of the target model's responses from baseline LLMs using embedding distances and LLM-as-a-Judge evaluations.
